text: Dependency ordering issue: step 5 of this bead's description says 'Move ... after PKIX-amgn.4 lands its refactor' but bd says amgn.4 is blocked-by amgn.2 (this bead). Needs untangling before work starts. Likely split: amgn.2a (empty skeleton crate with rustdoc header, no content), amgn.2b (move content from pkix-profiles), where amgn.2a blocks amgn.4 and amgn.4 blocks amgn.2b. Also: creating a new workspace crate touches workspace structure broadly — wanted explicit maintainer go-ahead before doing so even though parent epic PKIX-amgn endorses the split.
